train_dlrm_model: train a deep learning recommendation model (DLRM) with dense and sparse features using PyTorch
run_dlrm_inference: run inference-only mode on a trained DLRM model using --inference-only flag
export_dlrm_onnx: export a trained DLRM model to ONNX format using the --save-onnx flag
run_dlrm_distributed: run DLRM training in distributed mode across multiple ranks using --dist-backend
profile_dlrm_training: enable PyTorch profiling during DLRM training using the --enable-profiling flag
